lines.87: The rubric distinguishes debt-like terms (D), group equity (G), hybrids (H), plain outside equity (E) and unknown terms (U). The post-coding D split separates fixed-price or guaranteed-return claims (D1) from exits at market or project value (D2), which preserve project risk. Missing documents, available documents with incomplete terms, and transactions without an identifiable link to a capital receipt are distinct gaps.
